Corpus › Testing › छोड़ो

छोड़ो

Translation status: हिन्दी reader-locale proof. Term names and code fences follow the hi pack; supporting prose may still be English.

Marks a test case as skipped with a reason.

Aliases: skip

Syntax: परीक्षण <name> छोड़ो <reason> <block>

Category#

testing

Related#

  • परीक्षण
  • लंबित

Examples#

radix/corpus/omitte/omitte.fab (canonical · keyword)#

Marks a test case as skipped with a reason.

# =============================================================================
# छोड़ो — Marks a test case as skipped with a reason.
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • Test skipping — `छोड़ो` marks a test case to be skipped, with a required reason string.
#   • Test modifiers — Tests can be modified with `छोड़ो` to temporarily disable them.
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • Confusing छोड़ो (test skip) with मौन (no-op) — छोड़ो marks a test as skipped, मौन is an empty statement.
#
# See also: परीक्षण, लंबित
# =============================================================================

# छोड़ो — skipped test modifier
#
# GRAMMAR:
#   testModifier :← 'छोड़ो' stringLit
#
# EXPECTED OUTPUT:
#   No आरंभ — declaration or test-runner surface only.
#
# BACKEND:
#   declaration-only test modifier (whitelist: छोड़ो/omitte.fab).
#

test "database connection" skip "blocked" {
    assert false
}
